name: QRIS Technique-Aligned Procedure Profile (qrisTAPP)
abstract: Quantitative Reflectance Imaging System extension of the base TAPP definition. QRIS has no per-element analyte axis, so no ada:analyteTemplate is defined, and no mode-flag columns: its ADA componentTypes are pipeline stages of one acquisition, not modes. DRAFT - generated from draftTAPPs/QRIS_TAPP_draft_v2.csv by tools/build_tapp.py; the source table has not been through Phase 0 review.
